words.description: Boundless arcane power condensed into a single word.
Sweet arcane essence distilled from enchanted berries.
Increases accuracy and adds armor pierce
A small amphibian familiar, surprisingly magical.

spellTypes.name: Attack Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells designed to deal damage or incapacitate enemies.
rules: Pick an element, then optionally add an action or charge to shape the attack
Adding a Charge like Maxima greatly increases power and tier

spellTypes.name: Defense Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells that protect, shield, heal, ward areas, or transport the caster.
rules: Combine an element with a defensive command — the words you pick determine whether it heals, shields, wards, or teleports
Try Sano/Mendo for healing, Scuto/Tego for shields, Ligo for warding

spellTypes.name: Charm Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells that influence the minds of others.
rules: Choose words that suggest mental influence — charm, confuse, or beguile
Intent words refine how the charm affects targets

spellTypes.name: Illusion Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells that deceive senses, creating false perceptions.
rules: Pick elements that lend to trickery — Mirage, Shadow, Light work well
Add an Attribute to define what form the illusion takes

spellTypes.name: Enchantment Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells cast on the user — buffs, resistances, invisibility, self-enhancement.
rules: These affect YOU, not enemies — think concealment, speed, or resistance
The command describes how the element enhances your abilities

spellTypes.name: Conjuration Spells
spellTypes.description: Spells that materialize constructs, creatures, or phenomena from nothing.
rules: The Attribute slot defines WHAT you summon — creature, weapon, or object
Intent shapes the conjuration's purpose; Charge amplifies its power

spellTypes.name: Exploration Spells
spellTypes.description: Utility spells for interacting with the overworld environment.
rules: Choose an element, then optionally add a command to shape how it interacts with the world
Different element + command combos unlock different interaction types (break, reveal, burn, freeze, grow, push, sneak)
